The shared-note options don't fit this test. A union would return {3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10}, and a same-index zip comparison of `(3, 4, 5, 6)` and `(5, 7, 4, 10)` matches nothing, so both would fail the assertion. The intersection is the right approach.

```python
def similar_elements(test_tup1, test_tup2):
    return tuple(set(test_tup1) & set(test_tup2))


assert set(similar_elements((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10))) == set((4, 5))
```

CONFIDENCE: 97
